### Three PM assumptions, measured

- **Tmpdir collision between concurrent test files — FALSIFIED.** All four fixture repos here
  already use `fs.mkdtempSync`; `packages/spec` has exactly one vitest project; vitest isolates
  test files into separate processes. No concurrently running file can name one of them.
- **"The git helper already shells out per fixture; check whether it sets env per repo or
  inherits ambient config" — CONFIRMED, and that was the hole.** It inherited everything.
- **Fallback ③ (serialize the three git-topology describe blocks) — NOT APPLICABLE.** They are
  already serial: vitest runs one test at a time within a file. Implementing it would have been
  a no-op; the reason is recorded in the file instead.

The steward's flaky ledger was not touched.

- Out-of-scope exposure filed as **#9109** (two more git-fixture harnesses with the same inherited-env class, minus the shallow window), unassigned for triage.
